search.page_policy: first returned page only; inspect at most the first 20 results in provider order

exclusion_corpus.rule: Exclude bachikoljunior-blip/O, caru-ini/novelai-sdk, and any repository or exact issue already named anywhere in tracked O content at this commit.

eligibility_order: not an excluded repository or previously named exact issue
public, non-archived repository whose primary language is Python
open issue, not a pull request, classified as a non-security bug
issue body contains a maintainer-defined reproducer or failing-test description specific enough to freeze before implementation
default-branch exact commit and official test command can be identified without accessing an existing fix, answer, merged pull request, or hidden result
dependencies are locally installable without credentials or paid services within the frozen timeout
decision_rule: Walk candidates once in returned order, record a reason for every rejection, and stop permanently at the first eligible candidate. Do not substitute after baseline, implementation, or outcome is observed. If none is eligible, return bounded NO_ELIGIBLE_TARGET.
contamination_rule: Before target freeze, do not search for or open fix commits, pull requests, patches, answer links, downstream solutions, or hidden test results. Candidate issue bodies and repository metadata/readme/license/test configuration may be read only for eligibility.
post_selection_rule: Before baseline or solution work, publish a target commitment binding repository, issue, exact commit, issue-content digest, license, dependency environment, reproducer, focused and official test commands, success metric, timeout, negative control, clean replay, exclusions, and zero-upstream-write rule.
